definitions.explanation: The sound of thunder, typically heard during a thunderstorm.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}くで{雷鳴|らいめい}が{聞|き}こえた。
examples.english: I heard thunder in the distance.

examples.japanese: {雷鳴|らいめい}が{轟|とどろ}いた。
{激|はげ}しい{雷鳴|らいめい}と{稲光|いなびかり}で{目|め}が{覚|さ}めた。
examples.english: I woke up to intense thunder and lightning.

notes:
USAGE: {雷鳴|らいめい} is a more literary or formal word for thunder compared to {雷|かみなり}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{雷鳴|らいめい}が{轟|とどろ}く (thunder rumbles)
・{雷鳴|らいめい}が{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く (thunder resounds)
・{雷鳴|らいめい}が{聞|き}こえる (to hear thunder)

RELATED TERMS:
・{雷|かみなり} - thunder (more common, colloquial)
・{稲光|いなびかり} - lightning flash
・{稲妻|いなずま} - lightning bolt
・{落雷|らくらい} - lightning strike
・{雷雨|らいう} - thunderstorm

COMPARISON: While {雷|かみなり} can refer to both thunder and lightning, {雷鳴|らいめい} specifically refers only to the sound of thunder.
